svg.title: An ommat, a compound eye, decides 3 requests with a design of 9 questions: each round it sends the model only the questions that are ready, and rules settle a value or a marker from the answers

g.text: “Find my recent emails from Neo or Smith”
“Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at nine”
“Can you deal with that thing from yesterday”
a request arrives; the design holds 9 questions
round 1: the 3 questions that are ready go in one model call
a rule reads the answers and settles d:action
round 2: 2 more questions are asked, and the other 4 never are
asked 5 of 9 questions in 2 model calls; the turn is saved as a record
